prompt.v: A wheel of radius 10 centimeters turns at 150 revolutions per minute. How fast does a point on its rim move, in meters per second, to 1 decimal place?

problems.text: linear speed: r 10 cm, rpm 150, want m per s to 1 dp
problems.explain: ω = 150 × 2π = 300π radians per minute, so v = rω = 10 × 300π cm per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in meters, ÷ 100: 3000π ÷ 60 ÷ 100 ≈ 1.5708, which is 1.6 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 1.6 meters per second.

problems.explain: ω = 380 × 2π = 760π radians per minute, so v = rω = 10 × 760π cm per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in meters, ÷ 100: 7600π ÷ 60 ÷ 100 ≈ 3.9794, which is 4.0 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 4.0 meters per second.

problems.explain: ω = 260 × 2π = 520π radians per minute, so v = rω = 12 × 520π in per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in feet, ÷ 12: 6240π ÷ 60 ÷ 12 ≈ 27.2271, which is 27.2 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 27.2 feet per second.

problems.explain: ω = 530 × 2π = 1060π radians per minute, so v = rω = 15 × 1060π cm per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in meters, ÷ 100: 15900π ÷ 60 ÷ 100 ≈ 8.3252, which is 8.3 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 8.3 meters per second.

problems.explain: ω = 50 × 2π = 100π radians per minute, so v = rω = 17 × 100π in per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in feet, ÷ 12: 1700π ÷ 60 ÷ 12 ≈ 7.4176, which is 7.4 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 7.4 feet per second.

problems.explain: ω = 440 × 2π = 880π radians per minute, so v = rω = 20 × 880π cm per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in meters, ÷ 100: 17600π ÷ 60 ÷ 100 ≈ 9.2153, which is 9.2 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 9.2 meters per second.

problems.explain: ω = 150 × 2π = 300π radians per minute, so v = rω = 25 × 300π in per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in feet, ÷ 12: 7500π ÷ 60 ÷ 12 ≈ 32.7249, which is 32.7 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 32.7 feet per second.

problems.explain: ω = 270 × 2π = 540π radians per minute, so v = rω = 27 × 540π in per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in feet, ÷ 12: 14580π ÷ 60 ÷ 12 ≈ 63.6173, which is 63.6 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 63.6 feet per second.

problems.explain: ω = 520 × 2π = 1040π radians per minute, so v = rω = 30 × 1040π cm per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in meters, ÷ 100: 31200π ÷ 60 ÷ 100 ≈ 16.3363, which is 16.3 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 16.3 meters per second.

problems.explain: ω = 530 × 2π = 1060π radians per minute, so v = rω = 5 × 1060π in per minute. Per second, ÷ 60; in feet, ÷ 12: 5300π ÷ 60 ÷ 12 ≈ 23.1256, which is 23.1 to 1 decimal place. (Leaving out the 2π counts turns, not distance.) So 23.1 feet per second.

problems.explain: Each turn rolls one circumference, π × 70 cm. Per hour: π × 70 × 110 × 60 cm, and a kilometer is 100,000 cm: ≈ 14.5142, which is 14.5 to 1 decimal place. (The wheel's diameter, not its radius, goes with π here.) So 14.5 kilometers per hour.
